name: Diampromide
summary: Diampromide is an opioid analgesic from the ampromide family of drugs, related to other drugs such as propiram and phenampromide. It was invented in the 1960s by American Cyanamid, and can be described as a ring-opened analogue of fentanyl.

pharmacology.text: Diampromide produces similar effects to other opioids, including analgesia, sedation, dizziness and nausea, and is around the same potency as morphine.

summaryZh: 地恩丙胺（英語：diampromide），音譯狄安普魯密特，是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C21H28N2O，屬於開環芬太尼的同系物，能作為類阿片鎮痛藥，由美國氰胺公司在20世紀60年代發明。
